description: Tronçons de voirie du RVA supports aux données de trafic routier temps réel (FCD) is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche de données est une sélection de tronçons du référentiel voies et adresses de Rennes Métropole (RVA). Ces tronçons sont à apparier au flux de données "trafic en temps réel" distribué par la société Autoroute Trafic dans l'optique d'en générer un traficolor. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. Its keywords are trafic routier. The portal shows 2,859 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
